source: due2-native: an odrl:eq constraint with two odrl:rightOperandReference values (external review R07, #117)
notes: Not valid ODRL 2.2: odrl:rightOperandReference is one IRI, or a list for a set-based operator (IM 2.5.1), and odrl:eq is not set-based. odrl22-shape.ttl accepted it before #117. due2 rejects any rightOperandReference in stage 1, since resolving it would dereference an IRI (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3), so the policy is rejected for that whatever the count; the case pins the ODRL layer.

expected_rejection.why: ex:inRegion uses odrl:rightOperandReference, which due2 does not admit (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3). W1 rejects the policy in stage 1, so the stage-2 MalformedConstraint for its missing odrl:rightOperand is not reported.
